name: anymodel
description: Claude Code subagents on the models you choose: name as many agents as you like, each on a model from your own providers (LM Studio, Unsloth Studio, llama.cpp, vLLM, OpenRouter, any Anthropic-compatible API), and call them like Claude's own subagents while the main session stays on Claude.

agent.title: Agent name
agent.description: The name you call it by: @anymodel:<name>. A new name adds an agent; an existing one is updated with the fields you fill in. /anymodel lists yours.

url.title: Server URL
url.description: Base URL of a server that speaks the Anthropic Messages API, such as https://openrouter.ai/api or http://127.0.0.1:8888. Blank keeps the agent's own.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model id exactly as the server lists it, such as moonshotai/kimi-k3. Blank keeps the agent's own.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: For a server that needs one: kept in the macOS Keychain (on Linux, a file only you can read) and sent only to that server. Agents on one server share its key. Blank keeps the saved key.

context.title: Context size
context.description: In tokens, for a server that does not report it. Blank: read from the server.
